question: In which of the following states is Arulmigu Kapaleeshwarar Temple located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kapaleeshwarar Temple** is an ancient Hindu temple dedicated to** Lord Shiva** located in** Mylapore**, Tamil Nadu.
 
• It was built around the** 7th century CE** in the** Dravidian** style of temple architecture.
 
• Shiva is worshiped as Kapaleeswarar and is represented by the** lingam**.
 
• His consort** Parvati **is depicted as Karpagambal.
